content.title: 🌙 The moon of Jumadal Akhirah was not seen in Bangladesh today.
content.subtitle: The Ayyam al-Beed fasting days of this month will fall on November 24, 25, and 26.
content.body:
Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh.

The moon of Jumada al-Akhirah 1448 AH has not been sighted in the skies of Bangladesh today. Therefore, Jumada al-Ula will complete 30 days, and Jumada al-Akhirah will begin next Thursday, November 12.

The Ayyam al-Beed fasts of Jumada al-Akhirah will fall on November 24, 25, and 26, corresponding to Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, respectively.

This means you should have Suhoor on the night of Monday, November 23, and begin fasting on Tuesday, November 24.
content.author: Muslims Day
